caseTitle.en: Ants on the orthopaedic ward wall

condition.zh: 照會精神醫學 · 酒精戒斷

title.zh: 照會精神科的下午到深夜

tagline.zh: 照會單寫「精神病？」，答案藏在一個小酒瓶裡
tagline.en: The consult says “psychosis?”; the answer is hidden in a small bottle

desc.zh: 接骨科的照會：先問最後一杯酒，再看注意力，再看頭部影像。病人說牆上有螞蟻的時候，你要分得出譫妄和精神病。
desc.en: Take the orthopaedic consult: ask about the last drink first, then attention, then the head scan. When the patient sees ants on the wall, you must tell delirium from psychosis.

desc.zh: 戒斷評估量表、床邊安全、抽痰和氧氣都在你手上。他抽搐的那一分鐘，你是第一個到床邊的人。
desc.en: The withdrawal scale, bedside safety, suction and oxygen are yours. In the minute he seizes, you are first to the bed.

about.zh: 口袋裡永遠有一顆橘子，從沒看他吃完。進病房第一句話永遠是：最後一杯什麼時候喝的？
about.en: Always a tangerine in his pocket, never seen finished. His first question on any ward: when was the last drink?

about.zh: 記得每一床的拖鞋顏色。她說：病人怪怪的，先量血壓血糖，再寫照會。
about.en: Remembers every patient's slipper colour. Her rule: if a patient seems odd, check pressure and glucose before writing a consult.

about.zh: 會打鋼釘，不太會問喝酒。照會單上的問號是他畫的，而且畫得很大。
about.en: Good with plates and screws, less so with drinking histories. The big question mark on the consult is his.

role.zh: 右腳踝骨折術後第二天

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。五十四歲，跑夜班的計程車司機。在排班站滑倒摔斷腳踝。愛講笑話，笑話越講越快。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Fifty-four, a night-shift taxi driver who slipped at the taxi rank and broke his ankle. Loves jokes; tells them faster and faster.

about.zh: 在市場賣菜，每天收攤後騎車來。今天在他的包包裡找到一個小酒瓶，一直握在手裡不知道要不要拿出來。
about.en: Sells vegetables at the market and rides over after closing. Today she found a small bottle in his bag and keeps it in her hand, unsure whether to show it.

about.zh: 講電話會先說床號再說重點，從不跳過複誦。
about.en: Says the bed number first and the point second on every call, and never skips the read-back.

plain.zh: 一個科請另一個科的醫師來看病人、給建議。好的照會單寫清楚想問什麼。
plain.en: One team asks another specialty to see a patient and advise. A good consult says exactly what the question is.

plain.zh: 每天喝酒的人突然停喝，大腦少了酒的「煞車」，變得過度興奮：手抖、流汗、心跳快、睡不著，嚴重時抽搐或譫妄。
plain.en: When a daily drinker suddenly stops, the brain loses alcohol's brake and over-fires: shaking, sweating, a fast heart, no sleep, and in severe cases seizures or delirium.

plain.zh: 手不自主地抖。戒斷的手抖常在早上最明顯，伸直手指就看得出來。
plain.en: Involuntary shaking of the hands. Withdrawal tremor is often worst in the morning and shows when the fingers are held out.

plain.zh: 護理師依固定項目打分數：手抖、流汗、焦躁、幻覺、定向感等。分數決定多久再評一次、何時通知醫師、何時依醫囑給藥。
plain.en: A structured score nurses use: tremor, sweating, agitation, hallucinations, orientation and more. The score sets how often to reassess, when to call and when to give medication per order.

plain.zh: 大腦急性的當機：注意力不集中、時好時壞、晚上更糟。一定有身體原因，要找。
plain.en: An acute brain failure: poor attention, fluctuating, worse at night. There is always a physical cause, and it must be found.

plain.zh: 最嚴重的酒精戒斷：混亂、幻覺、發燒、心跳血壓飆高。這是醫療急症，常需要加護病房。
plain.en: The most severe alcohol withdrawal: confusion, hallucinations, fever, racing pulse and blood pressure. A medical emergency that often needs intensive care.

plain.zh: 停酒後大腦過度興奮引起的全身抽搐，多半在停喝後一兩天內。發生過一次，代表戒斷正在變重。
plain.en: A generalised fit from the over-excited brain after stopping alcohol, usually within a day or two. One seizure means withdrawal is getting worse.

plain.zh: 大腦用糖時需要的維生素。長期喝酒、吃得少的人常常缺。先補它，再給糖，保護大腦。
plain.en: The vitamin the brain needs to burn sugar. Long-term drinkers who eat little are often short of it. Give it before or with sugar to protect the brain.

plain.zh: 缺維生素 B1 造成的急性腦損傷：混亂、眼球動不好或眼震、走路不穩。及早補充可以逆轉，拖久會留下記憶障礙。
plain.en: Acute brain injury from thiamine lack: confusion, abnormal eye movements or nystagmus, unsteady gait. Early replacement can reverse it; delay can leave lasting memory loss.

plain.zh: 腦和硬腦膜之間的出血。常喝酒的人跌倒後可以慢慢出血，症狀像喝醉或譫妄。
plain.en: Bleeding between the brain and its tough outer lining. In regular drinkers it can ooze slowly after a fall and look just like drunkenness or delirium.

plain.zh: 請病人畫一個時鐘、標上數字和指定時間。考注意力、規劃和空間能力，床邊幾十秒就能做。
plain.en: The patient draws a clock with the numbers and a set time. It tests attention, planning and spatial skill in under a minute at the bedside.

plain.zh: 抽搐停止後讓病人側躺，口水和嘔吐物流得出來，呼吸道保持暢通。
plain.en: Lying the patient on their side after a seizure so saliva and vomit drain out and the airway stays open.

plain.zh: 不說教、不貼標籤，問對方自己想改變什麼、擔心什麼，讓改變的理由從他嘴裡說出來。
plain.en: No lectures and no labels: ask what the person wants to change and what worries them, so the reasons to change come out of their own mouth.

text.zh: 床放到最低、床欄套軟墊、腳踝的支架固定好。混亂的病人想下床時，低床比約束帶安全。
text.en: Bed at its lowest, padded rails, the ankle splint secured. When a confused patient tries to get up, a low bed is safer than a restraint.

text.zh: 抽搐病人的床邊，抽吸管接好、氧氣面罩在手邊。每一班開始都要試一次抽吸有沒有力。
text.en: At the bed of anyone at risk of seizures: suction connected, oxygen mask within reach. Test the suction at the start of every shift.

text.zh: 戒斷時心跳、血壓、體溫一起往上爬。趨勢比單一數字重要，夜班要看得到螢幕。
text.en: In withdrawal, pulse, pressure and temperature climb together. The trend matters more than any single number; the night team must be able to see the screen.

text.zh: 譫妄的人在黑暗中看到更多東西。開一盞小燈、掛一個看得到的時鐘，比多一句「你不要亂動」有用。
text.en: A delirious person sees more things in the dark. A small light and a visible clock help more than one more “stop moving”.

text.zh: 阿德畫的時鐘：十二個數字全擠在右半邊，指針指向「下班」。他說：這比我的班表還準。
text.en: Ah-De's clock: all twelve numbers crammed into the right half, the hands pointing at “off duty”. He said: more accurate than my rota.

name.zh: 內外科病房的新幻覺先當身體病
name.en: New hallucinations on a medical ward are medical first

text.zh: 一個以前沒有精神病史的人，住院後突然看到東西，最可能的是譫妄，不是精神病。分辨的關鍵是注意力：譫妄的人注意力會散、時好時壞、晚上更糟，而且多半是看到東西（視幻覺）。先找原因：戒斷、感染、疼痛、缺氧、血糖鈉離子異常、尿滯留、便秘、新加的藥、頭部外傷。找到原因並處理，幻覺才會退。
text.en: Someone with no psychiatric history who suddenly sees things in hospital is most likely delirious, not psychotic. The key is attention: in delirium it wanders, fluctuates and worsens at night, and the hallucinations are usually visual. Look for causes: withdrawal, infection, pain, low oxygen, abnormal glucose or sodium, urinary retention, constipation, a new drug, a head injury. Treat the cause and the hallucinations recede.

text.zh: 從最後一杯開始算：幾小時內手抖、流汗、焦躁；一兩天內可能出現幻覺和抽搐；兩到四天左右是震顫性譫妄的高峰。所以「最後一杯是什麼時候」是照會的第一個問題，也是夜班最需要知道的一行字。住院中偷喝會把時鐘重設，要問清楚。處置依戒斷評估量表和醫囑：安靜明亮的環境、補充維生素 B1、依分數給藥、必要時轉加護病房。
text.en: Count from the last drink: within hours, tremor, sweating and agitation; within a day or two, possible hallucinations and seizures; around two to four days, the peak of delirium tremens. So “when was the last drink” is the first question of the consult and the line the night team most needs. A secret drink in hospital resets the clock, so ask plainly. Management follows the withdrawal scale and orders: a calm, lit room, thiamine, medication by score, and intensive care if needed.

text.zh: 長期喝酒又吃得少的人，大腦的維生素 B1 存量很低。突然給大量葡萄糖，大腦燒糖時把僅剩的 B1 用光，可能誘發魏尼克腦病變。所以先補 B1 或同時給；但真正的低血糖不能等，兩件事一起做。看到混亂、眼震、走路不穩三者之一，就要想到它。
text.en: Long-term drinkers who eat little have almost no thiamine left in reserve. A large glucose load makes the brain burn through the last of it and can trigger Wernicke's encephalopathy. So give thiamine first or together; but true hypoglycaemia cannot wait, so do both at once. Confusion, nystagmus or an unsteady gait, any one of them, should make you think of it.

note.zh: 第一個問題：最後一杯是什麼時候
note.en: First question: when was the last drink

guide.zh: 到骨科護理站看照會單
guide.en: Read the consult at the station

sub.zh: 15 床：術後看到螞蟻，請評估精神病？
sub.en: Bed 15: seeing ants after surgery. Psychosis?

lines.zh: 下午一點。照會單上的問號畫得很大。方主治從口袋掏出一顆橘子，放在櫃台上。
lines.en: One in the afternoon. The question mark on the consult is very large. Dr Fang takes a tangerine from his pocket and sets it on the counter.

lines.zh: 15 床阿德，腳踝術後第二天。早上開始手抖、一直流汗，說牆上有螞蟻在排隊。
lines.en: Bed 15, Ah-De, day two after his ankle. Since this morning he shakes, sweats nonstop and says ants are queuing on the wall.

lines.zh: 他以前沒有精神病史。我想說，會不會是精神病發作？
lines.en: No psychiatric history. I wondered if it's a psychotic break?

lines.zh: 照會的第一個問題，你來問。
lines.en: The first question of this consult. You ask it.

lines.zh: 他最後一杯酒是什麼時候喝的？
lines.en: When did he have his last drink?

lines.zh: 對。內外科病房的新幻覺，先當成身體的病。
lines.en: Right. New hallucinations on a surgical ward are a body problem until proven otherwise.

guide.en: Take a drinking history at bed 15

lines.zh: 醫生，我沒喝多少啦！跑夜班的，喝一點提神而已。你知道計程車為什麼不怕下雨嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, I barely drink! Night shift, just a little to keep going. Know why taxis aren't scared of rain?

lines.zh: 他的手伸出來指牆，抖得很細、很快。額頭全是汗。
lines.en: He points at the wall with a fine, fast tremor. His forehead is soaked.

lines.zh: 這題寫的是咖啡和沒睡，原則一樣：先把物質和睡眠的時間排出來。
lines.en: This exercise is about coffee and no sleep, but the principle is the same: line up the substances and the sleep first.

post.zh: 醫生……這個在他包包裡。昨天早上他說要去廁所，去好久。
post.en: Doctor… this was in his bag. Yesterday morning he went to the toilet and stayed a long time.

post.zh: 美珠攤開手：一個空的小米酒瓶。
post.en: Mei-chu opens her hand: an empty little bottle of rice wine.

post.zh: 時鐘重設了。最後一杯是昨天早上，在醫院的廁所裡。
post.en: The clock has reset. The last drink was yesterday morning, in a hospital toilet.

lines.zh: 從現在開始用戒斷評估量表。你來，順序對了，夜班才接得住。
lines.en: From now on we use the withdrawal scale. You do it; get the order right so nights can pick it up.

steps.zh: 確認最後一杯的時間並寫下
steps.en: Confirm and record the time of the last drink

steps.zh: 依分數通報並決定再評時間
steps.en: Report by score and set the next check

post.zh: 分數不低。我先通知方主治，然後把再評估時間寫在白板上。
post.en: Not a low score. I'll tell Dr Fang, then write the next check time on the board.

lines.zh: 精神病和譫妄，最大的差別在哪裡？
lines.en: What separates psychosis from delirium most of all?

lines.zh: 注意力。譫妄的人注意力會散，時好時壞。
lines.en: Attention. In delirium it wanders and comes and goes.

lines.zh: 那就從外表開始，一路看到注意力。
lines.en: Then start at appearance and work your way to attention.

post.zh: 流汗、撿床單；月份倒著念念到一半就忘了；不知道今天星期幾。
post.en: Sweating, picking at the sheet; lost halfway through the months backwards; doesn't know the day.

post.zh: 譫妄。照會單上的問號可以改成一個答案了。
post.en: Delirium. The question mark on the consult can become an answer.

guide.en: Ask Ah-De to draw a clock

lines.zh: 阿德哥，幫我畫一個時鐘，數字寫上去，指針畫十一點十分。
lines.en: Ah-De, draw me a clock, put the numbers in, and the hands at ten past eleven.

lines.zh: 十二個數字全擠在右半邊。他畫了兩根針，都指著右下角。
lines.en: All twelve numbers squeeze into the right half. He draws two hands, both pointing bottom right.

lines.zh: 這是下班時間啦。這個時鐘比我的班表還準。
lines.en: That's knocking-off time. This clock's more accurate than my rota.

lines.zh: 畫鐘測驗不是考畫畫，是考注意力和規劃。留著，明天再畫一次比較。
lines.en: The clock-drawing test isn't an art exam; it tests attention and planning. Keep it and compare tomorrow.

guide.zh: 把床邊整理成安全的空間

lines.zh: 會談室安全那一套，搬到床邊也成立：出口、可以拿來傷人的東西、燈光。
lines.en: The interview-room safety rules work at a bedside too: the exit, anything that could hurt, the light.

post.zh: 床放到最低、床欄加墊、電線收好、小夜燈開了。時鐘掛在他看得到的地方。
post.en: Bed lowest, rails padded, cables tidied, night light on. The clock hangs where he can see it.

note.zh: 先 B1 再糖；頭部沒有出血
note.en: Thiamine before sugar; no bleed on the head scan

sub.zh: 15 床血糖偏低，骨科想接葡萄糖點滴
sub.en: Bed 15 glucose low; ortho wants a dextrose drip

lines.zh: 阿德的指尖血糖偏低，他兩天幾乎沒吃。何醫師想直接接葡萄糖點滴。
lines.en: Ah-De's fingerstick glucose is low; he's barely eaten in two days. Dr Ho wants to start a dextrose drip straight away.

lines.zh: 一個天天喝、很少吃的人。點滴之前少了什麼？
lines.en: A man who drinks daily and eats little. What is missing before that drip?

q.zh: 營養差的飲酒者血糖偏低，你怎麼建議？
q.en: A poorly nourished drinker with low glucose. Your advice?

options.zh: 先給維生素 B1，同時處理低血糖
options.en: Thiamine first, while treating the low glucose

why.zh: B1 存量低的人大量給糖，可能誘發魏尼克腦病變。先補或同時補；真正的低血糖不能拖。
why.en: In someone short of thiamine, a load of glucose can trigger Wernicke's encephalopathy. Give it first or together; true hypoglycaemia cannot wait.

options.zh: 血糖低，先上葡萄糖再說
options.en: Glucose is low; start dextrose and see

why.zh: 低血糖要處理，但只給糖不給 B1，大腦燒糖時會把最後一點 B1 用光。
why.en: The low glucose needs treating, but sugar without thiamine makes the brain burn through its last reserve.

options.zh: 等明天精神科門診再評估

why.zh: 戒斷在變重，低血糖也在眼前。照會就是今天的事。
why.en: Withdrawal is worsening and the glucose is low now. A consult is today's job.

post.zh: 複誦：維生素 B1 依醫囑先給，低血糖同時處理。我轉告何醫師。
post.en: Read-back: thiamine per order first, glucose treated alongside. I'll tell Dr Ho.

lines.zh: 他在排班站滑倒，入院有照頭部電腦斷層，我還沒仔細看。
lines.en: He slipped at the taxi rank. He had a head CT on admission; I haven't looked closely.

lines.zh: 為什麼喝酒的人跌倒，頭部影像特別重要？
lines.en: Why does head imaging matter so much when a drinker falls?

question.zh: 天天喝酒、跌倒、現在新的混亂。頭部斷層要找什麼？看完就能排除問題嗎？
question.en: Daily drinker, a fall, new confusion. What are you looking for on the head CT, and does a clear scan settle it?

answer.zh: 找硬腦膜下出血：飲酒者腦萎縮、凝血較差，跌倒後可以慢慢滲血，症狀像酒醉或譫妄。入院片子沒有出血，但不代表之後不會出；若出現新的局部神經症狀、意識越來越差、或抽搐後一直不醒，要再照。
answer.en: A subdural haematoma: drinkers have shrunken brains and weaker clotting, so a fall can ooze slowly and look like drunkenness or delirium. The admission scan shows no bleed, but that does not rule out a later one; new focal signs, a falling level of consciousness or not waking after a seizure mean scan again.

post.zh: 沒有出血。這張片子給我們的是一條基準線，不是保證書。
post.en: No bleed. This scan gives us a baseline, not a guarantee.

guide.en: Check the drug chart with Dr Ho

lines.zh: 術後加了止痛藥。他在家有沒有吃安眠藥？住院後有沒有繼續？
lines.en: Painkillers were added after surgery. Does he take a sleeping pill at home, and was it continued here?

lines.zh: 呃……入院藥單上沒寫。
lines.en: Er… it isn't on the admission list.

lines.zh: 這題寫的是情緒病程，但重點一樣：新症狀和藥物的先後順序要排出來。
lines.en: This exercise is about mood episodes, but the point is the same: line up new symptoms against drug changes.

post.zh: 他睡前會吃一顆醫生開的藥，吃好幾年了。我以為醫院知道。
post.en: He takes a pill from his doctor every night, for years. I thought the hospital knew.

post.zh: 酒停了、安眠藥也停了，兩個煞車同時放掉。藥單今天要補齊。
post.en: Alcohol stopped and the sleeping pill stopped: two brakes released at once. The drug list gets completed today.

note.zh: 不貼標籤，問他自己想改變什麼
note.en: No labels; ask what he wants to change

lines.zh: 他不是壞人。跑夜班睡不著，就喝一點，喝一點變成每天。
lines.en: He's not a bad man. Night shifts, can't sleep, so a little drink, and a little became every day.

lines.zh: 我們不是來罵他的。是要讓他這幾天平安度過，然後問他自己想怎麼做。
lines.en: We're not here to scold him. We want him through these days safely, then ask what he wants to do.

lines.zh: 動機式晤談：改變的理由要從他自己嘴裡說出來，不是我們的。
lines.en: Motivational interviewing: the reasons to change must come out of his mouth, not ours.

lines.zh: 他上次說，想陪女兒走紅毯。她明年結婚。
lines.en: He said once he wants to walk our daughter down the aisle. She's getting married next year.

lines.zh: 醫生，病歷不要寫「酒」好不好？車行會看到，我會沒工作。
lines.en: Doctor, please don't write “alcohol” in the chart. The taxi company will see it; I'll lose my job.

q.zh: 病人請你不要在病歷寫飲酒。你怎麼回？
q.en: He asks you to leave alcohol out of the chart. Your reply?

options.zh: 說明誰看得到病歷，照實但尊重地寫
options.en: Explain who sees the chart; write it accurately and respectfully

why.zh: 病歷受保密保護，雇主不能隨意調閱。少寫一行，夜班就不知道他在戒斷，那才危險。
why.en: The record is confidential; an employer cannot simply read it. Leave the line out and nights won't know he's withdrawing, which is the real danger.

options.en: Fine, I'll leave it out this time

why.zh: 這是安全資訊。漏掉它，下一個團隊會把抽搐當成謎題。
why.en: This is safety information. Leave it out and the next team will treat a seizure as a mystery.

options.zh: 警告他再喝就通報車行
options.en: Warn him you'll report him to the company if he drinks again

why.zh: 威脅會讓他下次隱瞞得更深，也違反保密。
why.en: Threats make him hide more next time, and they break confidentiality.

post.en: …Then write it nicely. Write that I'm handsome.

post.zh: 我寫：「病人主動談飲酒，希望明年陪女兒走紅毯。」
post.en: I'll write: “Patient discussed his drinking openly; wants to walk his daughter down the aisle next year.”

note.zh: 戒斷性癲癇；側躺、計時、叫人

lines.zh: 晚餐托盤剛送到。阿德講到一半，眼睛往上吊，全身一僵，接著四肢規律地抽動。
lines.en: The dinner tray has just arrived. Mid-joke, Ah-De's eyes roll up, his body stiffens, then his limbs jerk rhythmically.

lines.zh: 阿德！阿德！
lines.en: Ah-De! Ah-De!

options.zh: 護頭、計時、叫人，停後側躺，備氧氣抽吸
options.en: Protect head, time it, call for help, then side-lying with oxygen and suction ready

why.zh: 大多數抽搐會自己停。你的工作是不讓他受傷、記下時間、把團隊叫來，依抽搐流程處理。
why.en: Most seizures stop on their own. Your job is to prevent injury, note the time, bring the team and follow the seizure protocol.

options.zh: 壓住手腳，塞東西到嘴裡
options.en: Hold his limbs down and put something in his mouth

why.zh: 壓手腳會造成骨折或脫臼；嘴裡塞東西會斷牙、堵住呼吸道。舌頭不會被吞下去。
why.en: Holding limbs can fracture or dislocate them; anything in the mouth breaks teeth and blocks the airway. Tongues are not swallowed.

options.en: Wheel him straight to the CT scanner

why.zh: 抽搐中不能搬運。先處理呼吸道和安全；之後若一直不醒或有局部症狀，再決定是否照。
why.en: You don't transport a seizing patient. Airway and safety first; afterwards, if he stays unresponsive or has focal signs, decide on a scan.

post.zh: 抽動在不到兩分鐘時停下。他側躺著，打呼似地呼吸，口水流到枕頭上。
post.en: The jerking stops in under two minutes. He lies on his side, breathing noisily, saliva running onto the pillow.

post.zh: 復原姿勢做得好。這是戒斷性癲癇，表示戒斷正在變重。依流程給藥，轉到有監視器的床位，加護病房先打招呼。
post.en: Good recovery position. That's a withdrawal seizure: withdrawal is getting worse. Medicate per protocol, move him to a monitored bed, and give the ICU a heads-up.

lines.zh: 抽吸管和氧氣面罩，在哪裡你閉著眼睛也要找得到。
lines.en: Suction and an oxygen mask: you should find them with your eyes closed.

q.zh: 找到急救車和床邊抽吸
q.en: Find the crash cart and bedside suction

post.zh: 抽吸有力，面罩接好了。下一班開始前，我們再試一次。
post.en: Suction pulls well, mask connected. We test it again before the next shift.

lines.zh: 半小時後他醒了。眼睛追著你的手指左右移動，平穩，沒有眼震。
lines.en: Half an hour later he wakes. His eyes follow your finger left and right, smooth, no nystagmus.

lines.zh: B1 下午就給了。至少魏尼克腦病變這條路，我們先關起來了。
lines.en: The thiamine went in this afternoon. At least we've shut the door on Wernicke's encephalopathy.

lines.zh: 他醒了，眼睛往旁邊看時一直抖，扶他坐起來整個人往一邊倒。
lines.en: He wakes, but his eyes flicker when he looks sideways, and when you sit him up he topples to one side.

lines.zh: 眼震加上不穩，還有混亂。這是魏尼克腦病變的樣子。現在立刻依醫囑補 B1。
lines.en: Nystagmus, unsteadiness and confusion. That is Wernicke's encephalopathy. Thiamine per order, now.

lines.zh: 晚補比不補好。下次低血糖遇到喝酒的人，B1 先寫在醫囑的第一行。
lines.en: Late is better than never. Next time a drinker has low glucose, thiamine goes on the first line of the orders.

note.zh: 交班：最後一杯、量表頻率、誰可以叫
note.en: Handover: last drink, scale frequency, who to call

guide.en: Hand over to nights at the board

lines.zh: 15 床阿德：最後一杯昨天早上；下午譫妄、傍晚一次戒斷性癲癇。
lines.en: Bed 15, Ah-De: last drink yesterday morning; delirious this afternoon, one withdrawal seizure at dusk.

lines.zh: 戒斷評估量表依醫囑頻率評；分數升高或再抽搐，打給照會和重症團隊。
lines.en: Withdrawal scale at the ordered frequency; a rising score or another seizure, call liaison and the ICU team.

lines.zh: 我在白板上寫了：「最後一杯：昨天早上，廁所。」這一行最重要。
lines.en: I've written on the board: “Last drink: yesterday morning, toilet.” That's the most important line.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：照會的第一個問題是最後一杯；新的幻覺先找身體原因；先 B1 再糖。
lines.en: Three things today: a consult's first question is the last drink; new hallucinations mean look for the body first; thiamine before sugar.

lines.zh: 還有一件：他說要陪女兒走紅毯。那句話比我們任何一句衛教都有用。
lines.en: And one more: he wants to walk his daughter down the aisle. That sentence will do more than any leaflet of ours.

lines.zh: 他把那顆橘子剝了一半，又放回口袋。
lines.en: He peels half the tangerine and puts it back in his pocket.

note.zh: 先找原因與安全，約束是最後手段
note.en: Causes and safety first; restraints last

sub.zh: 15 床躁動拔點滴，要不要約束？
sub.en: Bed 15 agitated, pulling his drip. Restraints?

lines.zh: 15 床。他說螞蟻爬到點滴管上了，一直要拔。量表分數升高，心跳也快。要不要綁？
lines.en: Bed 15. He says ants are climbing the drip line and keeps pulling it. Scale score up, pulse fast too. Shall we restrain him?

lines.zh: 先看體溫、血氧、血糖、尿有沒有脹。依戒斷流程的醫囑給藥，小夜燈開著，告訴他現在幾點、在哪裡。
lines.en: Check temperature, saturation, glucose and whether his bladder is full. Medicate per the withdrawal protocol order, keep the night light on, tell him the time and place.

lines.zh: 請美珠在電話裡跟他說話。如果發燒、越來越混亂，就是震顫性譫妄，我現在請重症團隊來看。約束是最後手段。
lines.en: Put Mei-chu on the phone to him. If he spikes a fever or gets more confused, it's delirium tremens and I'll get the ICU team now. Restraints are the last resort.

lines.zh: 複誦：查原因、依流程給藥、燈和時間、太太的聲音、重症團隊評估，約束最後。
lines.en: Read-back: look for causes, protocol medication, light and the time, his wife's voice, ICU team review, restraints last.

lines.zh: ……他聽到太太的聲音，安靜了。他說：跟她說，酒的事我不該騙她。
lines.en: …He heard his wife's voice and settled. He says: tell her I shouldn't have lied about the drinking.

lines.zh: 你掛上電話。值班室的桌上，有人留了半顆橘子。
lines.en: You hang up. On the on-call room desk, someone has left half a tangerine.

sub.zh: 照會的第一個問題：最後一杯什麼時候喝的
sub.en: A consult's first question: when was the last drink?
